quotes.speaker: Tim Connelly
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim Connelly explains the reasoning behind the trade for LaMelo Ball.
quotes.excerpt: We think kind of the age appropriateness of LaMelo with this young core will fit very well
quotes.quote: I think we were disappointed we didn't probably weren't the best version of ourselves last year in the playoffs, but we also know how hard high the bar is in the Western Conference. We always said we'd only make a deal if we thought it would make us better not just here and now for the long term. We think kind of the age appropriateness of LaMelo with this young core will fit very well, so we got off a bunch of really, really good players, they're going to have great years elsewhere, but we're very aware of what we have to overcome and how difficult that task will be and we think we're more prepared than ever.
quotes.social_post: Tim Connelly discusses the trade for LaMelo Ball and how he fits the team's young core for the long term.

quotes.speaker: Rudy Gobert

quotes.excerpt: the business of the NBA forces you to adapt and evolve
quotes.quote: I think the game the business of the NBA forces you to adapt and evolve. You know the the game the game keeps growing and and also it's also hard to always keep the same core. You know, so we have the same I mean we we we lost two of our very important players and we brought in Lamelo, but we still have the mostly the same core, so we we we want to keep some of those those those core values and and that core identity, but also adapt a little bit.

quotes.speaker: Chris Finch
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Finch outlines tactical changes for the upcoming season.
quotes.excerpt: We should be faster, a little bit faster, I think just physically faster
quotes.quote: There's certainly things that we can lean into that we haven't necessarily done that haven't fit our previous rosters. I can see a lot more four around one, even small ball at times, a lot more guard guard, smalls actions, pick and roll so prevalent in the league these days. We should be faster, a little bit faster, I think just physically faster, more aggressive on the defensive end as a result. We can put ourselves in rotations more purposefully now, doubling, being a bit more aggressive, trying to force either force turnovers or hide some mismatches that we might be on the short end of too. So I think there are there's a lot of things we have to kind of figure out, but we always keep the principles the high level fundamentals are always the same and how we get there might be a little different.
quotes.social_post: Chris Finch says the team will play faster and be more aggressive on defense this season.
